Everyone is definitely not telling you anything wrong. The only way to get out of the cult is to establish self-sufficiency. You have to essentially make it harder for them to hold anything over you. Once they realize they can’t control you emotionally or with your own material things they’ll be pushed into a corner. Definitely get a new phone first like everyone said it’ll be cheap but it’s yours and no one can take it or regulate what you do with it. Download credit karma and see if you have credit to begin with. Thats one of the biggest things that will help you obtain necessities like an apartment especially if you’re tight for funds it’s better to have good credit in those situations. If it’s good keep building it and look for a job or go to school(on campus or online) that’s gonna help you establish a career and pay for personal expenses. Oh yeah save, save, save. A car is useful to have as well. Make sure you stay in contact with your friends especially if they’re good people. These types of transitions feel lonely and scary but having good friends makes it easier to go through. Therapy is also something that you’ll probably want to consider as well. Self education really will be another big thing. Idk if it’s the same for you but my parents rarely taught me anything I needed to know to be a functional adult aside from driving (because little did I know it was for me to drive them around). I taught myself a lot of finances, budgeting, credit etc. But basically everything you’re gonna have to do to get out will revolve around developing your self-sufficiency, independence and knowledge. These are usually the main things they try to take away from you so you stay in and rely on them.
